paragraphs: Passio Technologies sells transit and parking technology, offered as modular solutions to transit companies of any size and type. The homepage sets out real time passenger information drawn from GPS tracking, automated voice announcements, on-board LED smart signs, automated passenger counting and computer aided dispatch. Operations management and reporting run through Passio Navigator and Passio OpsView, with alerts for speeding, off route, out of boundary and idling.

Other named products include Passio GO for riders on smartphones, Passio BusBuzz for passenger feedback by text, and Passio Gateway for boarding access using tap, swipe or scan technology. The about page adds contact tracing, an in app bus request feature, and paratransit and NEMT solutions following the acquisition of ParaPlan in 2019.

The pages name transit customers in the university, municipal, corporate, healthcare, aviation, residential and hospitality industries. Industries listed on the homepage include colleges and universities, municipalities, paratransit and NEMT, healthcare, corporate campuses, airports, shopping, employee transit and residential. The about page also says the client base numbers over 250 after more than 10 years in the industry.

quote.text: Driving Ahead with Intelligent Transit Technology
